import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class MinCostFlow {
    static class Edge {
        int to, next, val, w;
        Edge(int to, int next, int val, int w) {
            this.to = to;
            this.next = next;
            this.val = val;
            this.w = w;
        }
    }

    static class FlowData {
        int c, f;
        FlowData(int c, int f) {
            this.c = c;
            this.f = f;
        }
    }

    static final int MAX_SIZE = 5005;
    static final int MAX_EDGE = 4 * MAX_SIZE * (int)Math.sqrt(MAX_SIZE);
    static final int INFINITY_VAL = 1000000000;

    static int n, m, k, c, d, s, t, totalNodes, edgeIdx;
    static int[] preNode = new int[MAX_SIZE];
    static int[] head = new int[MAX_SIZE];
    static Edge[] edgeList = new Edge[MAX_EDGE << 1];

    static int[] distance = new int[MAX_SIZE];
    static boolean[] inQueue = new boolean[MAX_SIZE];

    static int[][] E = new int[MAX_SIZE][2];

    static int IDX2(int i, int j) {
        return i * n + j;
    }

    static void connectEdge(int u, int v, int val, int w) {
        edgeIdx++;
        edgeList[edgeIdx] = new Edge(v, head[u], val, w);
        head[u] = edgeIdx;
    }

    static void addEdgePair(int u, int v, int val, int w) {
        connectEdge(u, v, val, w);
        connectEdge(v, u, 0, -w);
    }

    static boolean bellmanFord() {
        Arrays.fill(distance, 1, totalNodes + 1, INFINITY_VAL);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        distance[s] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            inQueue[u] = false;
            for (int i = head[u]; i != 0; i = edgeList[i].next) {
                int v = edgeList[i].to;
                if (edgeList[i].val > 0 && distance[v] > distance[u] + edgeList[i].w) {
                    distance[v] = distance[u] + edgeList[i].w;
                    preNode[v] = i;
                    if (!inQueue[v]) {
                        inQueue[v] = true;
                        q.offer(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return distance[t] < INFINITY_VAL;
    }

    static FlowData minCostFlow() {
        int totalFlowC = 0;
        int totalFlowF = 0;
        while (bellmanFord()) {
            int flowCap = INFINITY_VAL;
            for (int x = t; x != s; x = edgeList[preNode[x] ^ 1].to) {
                flowCap = Math.min(flowCap, edgeList[preNode[x]].val);
            }
            for (int x = t; x != s; x = edgeList[preNode[x] ^ 1].to) {
                edgeList[preNode[x]].val -= flowCap;
                edgeList[preNode[x] ^ 1].val += flowCap;
            }
            totalFlowF += flowCap;
            totalFlowC += distance[t] * flowCap;
        }
        return new FlowData(totalFlowC, totalFlowF);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int startIdx = 2 * k;
        totalNodes = startIdx * n;
        s = ++totalNodes;
        t = ++totalNodes;

        Arrays.fill(head, 0, totalNodes + 1, 0);
        edgeIdx = 0;

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            int tp = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            addEdgePair(s, IDX2(0, tp), 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            E[i][0] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            E[i][1] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= startIdx - 1; i++) {
            addEdgePair(IDX2(i, 1), t, k, c * i);
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                addEdgePair(IDX2(i - 1, j), IDX2(i, j), k, 0);
            }
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                for (int tIdx = 1; tIdx <= k; tIdx++) {
                    addEdgePair(IDX2(i - 1, E[j][0]), IDX2(i, E[j][1]), 1, (2 * tIdx - 1) * d);
                    addEdgePair(IDX2(i - 1, E[j][1]), IDX2(i, E[j][0]), 1, (2 * tIdx - 1) * d);
                }
            }
        }

        FlowData result = minCostFlow();
        System.out.println(result.f);
    }
}
